supervisory_authorities.csirt: ngCERT / Office of the National Security Adviser

metadata.scope: Establishes independent commission replacing previous NDPR guidelines

statutory_frameworks.official_title: Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) Act 2015 as amended by Cybercrimes (Amendment) Act 2024
statutory_frameworks.supervisory_authority: Office of the National Security Adviser (ONSA) / ngCERT

metadata.cni_protection: Designation of Critical National Information Infrastructure (CNII)

cyber_security_mandates.baseline_standard_ref: Nigeria Cybersecurity Policy and Strategy / ISO/IEC 27001 / IEC 62443
cyber_security_mandates.mandatory_certifications: Annual Data Protection Compliance Audit (CAR); ngCERT CNII audit registration
cyber_security_mandates.details: Designated CNII operators must register with ONSA, implement continuous incident monitoring, and conduct mandatory annual vulnerability audits.

data_privacy_sovereignty.primary_privacy_law: Data Protection and Privacy Act of Nigeria
data_privacy_sovereignty.localization_scope: Sector-specific financial and government data localization where applicable.

cryptography_controls.crypto_export_controls: National Customs & Dual-Use Export Control Regime.
cryptography_controls.post_quantum_mandate: Monitoring international standard bodies (ISO/IEC JTC 1 / ITU-T).

incident_disclosure_rules.threshold_trigger_definition: NDPA Section 40: Data breach that is likely to result in risk to the rights and freedoms of the data subject.

sector_applicability.specific_obligations: Generation, transmission, distribution, and pipeline SCADA integrity.
Water treatment, distribution telemetry, and environmental control.
Hospital systems, medical device cybersecurity, and EHR data protection.
Payment systems, banking core networks, and cyber resilience audits.
Public telecommunications networks, submarine cables, and 5G security.
Machinery safety, industrial robotics, PLC programming, and safety instrumented systems.
Rail signaling, air traffic management, maritime port terminals, and connected vehicles.
